about: Where each family of Orsino's corpus goes in Kyr, written by hand: its destination, how it is represented there, what generation does with it, the tests that hold it, and its status. 'rule' says how an entry's own status is computed (src/registry/orsino-inventory.ts): ledger (the adaptation ledger and the generated catalogs' records), wonder, trap, mechanism, bark, climate; or family, where every entry takes the family's status. Statuses: integrated (in Kyr and met in play), represented (in Kyr's data, but play does not reach it, or reaches it with declared omissions), reference (kept in the registry only, because Kyr does this another way, said why), blocked (Kyr would carry it, but cannot yet: the blocker says exactly what is missing). Inventory: bun bin/orsino-registry.ts inventory.

alignment.blocker: Kyr judges people by what they do (allegiance, temperament and standing relations in data/rules), not by an alignment axis; a deity's or a creature's alignment is not consulted anywhere.

ancestry.representation: ancestry definitions with attribute modifiers, traits and classes allowed

background.representation: backgrounds with attribute changes, gear and the overlay's skills

class.representation: callings: hit die, modifiers, abilities, gear, spell slots
class.generative: protagonist and recruit callings; residents' callings

nobility.blocker: Kyr's lords and ladies are authored people with roles (a lord's toll in data/kits/toll-road); Orsino's title expression (houseHead, gender) has no Kyr house or family structure to read.

status.representation: conditions with modifiers, turn hooks and lifetimes
status.generative: applied by abilities, traps and wonders

aspect.representation: what an aspect adds to a creature: attributes and abilities
aspect.generative: a den's beasts, sometimes, drawn by rarity (src/world/region-ecology.ts); an author's Aspect in a Person

aspectRarity.generative: a den's aspect, drawn by rarity

combatEntity.representation: a construct species that takes its turn in a fight with the object's abilities and traits
combatEntity.generative: none yet: an author's Person of the species

companion.blocker: Orsino gives each ancestry its animal companions; Kyr's companions are the animals of the country (tame species in data/catalog/species.json) befriended in play, not a list by ancestry.

creatureOverlay.representation: the four undead templates any species can be laid under
creatureOverlay.generative: a barrow's or a ruin's beasts, sometimes

creatureTemplate.representation: what a template adds: attributes, traits and abilities
creatureTemplate.generative: a barrow's or a ruin's beasts, sometimes (skeletal, zombie), laid to rest by rites; an author's Undead in a Person

difficultyTier.representation: described in the generated Dungeon Master's Guide
difficultyTier.blocker: Kyr scales a country by its level and its peoples; Orsino's hit-point and armour tiers are not applied to Kyr creatures.

monsterRank.representation: described in the generated Monster Manual
monsterRank.blocker: Kyr's creatures take their level from the country and the work, not from Orsino's rank words.

npcRace.blocker: Kyr's people are made as characters are, from an ancestry, a calling and a level (src/world/community); Orsino's separate NPC stat blocks would make two rules for one kind of person.

npcRank.blocker: As npcRace: Kyr people have levels, not NPC ranks.

npcType.blocker: As npcRace. The types' combat barks are carried (npcBark), spoken by any fighter whose role names the type.

treasureTier.blocker: A work's treasure is drawn by its plan and its makers (src/world/region-works.ts); Orsino's tier weights are not consulted.

legendaryWonderRoll.blocker: Roll weights over wonders. A generated country draws evenly among the wonders Kyr can run (src/world/region-marvels.ts); a weighted roll would favour wonders that are often not runnable.

roomDecoration.blocker: Single words for a dungeon room's dressing ('a torch'); a generated work's rooms are written whole by its plan (data/generation/works), which says more than a decoration roll can.

roomOverlay.blocker: Chances that a room holds a fight, a trap, a puzzle, a wonder; Kyr's works place these by their plans (a trap on the inner way, a wonder beyond it).

roomSequence.blocker: As roomOverlay: a work's rooms follow its plan.

template.blocker: Orsino's character templates (animal, merchant) fill fields Kyr fills from ancestry, calling and background.

terrainRoll.blocker: Roll weights over terrain; Kyr's land is drawn from its height, water and climate (src/world/land).

trapRoll.blocker: Roll weights over traps; a generated work draws evenly among the traps Kyr can run within the harm cap (src/world/region-marvels.ts).

companionName.blocker: Kyr's animals are named by the people who keep them, in the country's language (src/world/community); Orsino's English pet names ('Bumble') would not fit a country speaking Old English or Aenean.

eventBark.generative: spoken in fights by data/voice/combat.json through src/narrative/barks.ts

language.destination: the languages package (../languages), read by src/world/place-names.ts
language.generative: every generated name of place, person and thing

npcBark.representation: voice rows (npc.<type>.*), spoken by a fighter whose role names the type

npcName.blocker: Kyr names people from the languages package in the country's own tongue; Orsino's English lists by ancestry are not drawn.

personalityBark.representation: voice rows (personality.<manner>.*), spoken by a companion of that manner

surname.blocker: As npcName: Kyr's people are known by forename and work ('Aelfric the eel-man').

arcaneSpell.generative: callings' spell lists; wonders that teach

rule.statusModifier.representation: modifier fields judged one by one

deityDraft.blocker: Names of real-world gods by domain (Eris, Kali); a generated country's gods are named in its own tongue (data/generation/tables/faith.json).

deityGender.generative: how a shrine speaks of its god

dungeon.blocker: Words for a dungeon's kind and look; Kyr's works are the makers' (src/world/history): their kinds come from the makers' art, not from a list.

plane.representation: a condition held by everyone fighting in a place: the plane's spell DC
plane.generative: none yet: an author's law(place, plane_*)

riddle.destination: data/generation/scenes/orsino-world.json#riddles, set on a work's sealed door by src/world/region-riddles.ts
riddle.representation: question, answer and kind, filtered to plain words
riddle.generative: a speaking door on the way into some of the makers' works (two in five)

riddleAnswer.representation: the words of each kind a door offers beside the answer
riddleAnswer.generative: three wrong words of the answer's kind on a speaking door

roomAura.blocker: A room's feel (claustrophobic); a work's rooms are written whole by its plan.

roomFeature.blocker: A feature offers an effect (a mana surge) a number of times; Kyr has the effect language and a Thing's states, but no counted offer ('=1d4' uses). A wonder gives once; a feature would need a measure on the thing.

settlementAffix.representation: the any-terrain affixes (borough, stead, hold, view) among Kyr's own
settlementAffix.generative: settlement names where the tongue gives no word

settlementSize.generative: a settlement's size and so its people (src/world/community)
settlementSize.blocker: Orsino's cities and capitals (1d100*100000 souls) are larger than anything a Kyr country's community plan can hold; only its town, village and hamlet are drawn.

shop.destination: data/generation/scenes/orsino-world.json#shops (stocked with the Kyr items of their kinds) and data/generation/scenes/shops.json, kept by src/world/region-shops.ts
shop.representation: a shop in a town, its keeper, and what it sells at what it is worth
shop.generative: a market town keeps two, any other town one

specialRoom.blocker: Rooms with set NPCs and treasure (an ancestral shrine's tomb-robbers); Kyr's works are populated by their history's newcomers and makers (src/world/region-renewal.ts).

terrain.blocker: Kyr's land is cover by cell (fen, wood, fell); Orsino's terrain modifiers to attributes and its word lists are not used.

trap.representation: a Hazard in Kyr's effect language on a Thing on a work's inner way
trap.generative: a work's inner way, three works in five

trapDc.generative: every generated trap saves against medium
trapDc.blocker: Only medium is used: a generated work has no depth or tier to choose easy, hard or deadly by.

trapMechanism.representation: how each mechanism is seen, understood and dealt with

trapTrigger.representation: a trap goes off when its way is crossed
trapTrigger.blocker: Kyr's traps go off on crossing; a trigger on opening or touching a thing is not yet written for generated traps.

wonder.representation: a Thing with a Change that, made once, strikes the company with a Hazard in Kyr's effect language
wonder.generative: two in a country's wild country, and some works
